title: Take Leads From Any Source, Answered by the Agent
summary: Point the lead emails from the sites you advertise on at one Ekho address, and each enquiry becomes a lead in your CRM, attributed to the site that sent it and answered by your AI Sales Agent. Your own website forms can use the same address.
body_markdown:
Summary


Point the lead emails from the sites you advertise on at one Ekho address, and each enquiry becomes a lead in your CRM, attributed to the site that sent it and answered by your AI Sales Agent. Your own website forms can use the same address.


You pay to put your inventory in front of buyers on the sites they shop. The enquiries those sites send back arrive as email, and an inbox is a poor place for a lead to sit. Point them at Ekho instead.


##


Any source that speaks ADF


Listing sites deliver their enquiries as ADF, the standard automotive lead format, and the[AI Sales Agent](https://www.ekho.com/sales-agent) now reads it. That covers the sites most dealers already run: Autotrader, Cars.com, CarGurus, Edmunds and TrueCar on the automotive side, and CycleTrader, ChopperExchange, Moto-Hunt, ATV Trader and Cyclecrunch on the powersports side. It is not a list we maintain. Any site that sends ADF works, including one you add next year.


##


What arrives


Forward the emails to the address your Ekho contact gives you and each one becomes a lead in your CRM, with the buyer's details and the vehicle they asked about already attached. The agent picks it up the way it picks up any other lead: it answers, it qualifies, and it books.


The Leads table in the Admin Portal: every lead carries the site it arrived from.


##


The source travels with the lead


Every lead records the site that sent it. Filter on it and you can see which of the sites you pay for produce buyers who go on to purchase, rather than which produce the most enquiries.


##


Where to find it


In the Admin Portal, open CRM. New leads appear in the table with the sending site recorded against them, and each buyer's thread sits in Conversations. Ask your Ekho contact for the forwarding address and to register your dealership against it.


## Frequently asked questions
